newsitem.title: USA: St. Jude Medical to begin trading on NYSE. [CORRECTED 17:02 GMT 2/12]
newsitem.headline: St. Jude Medical to begin trading on NYSE. [CORRECTED 17:02 GMT 2/12]

text.p: The New York Stock Exchange said on Wednesday that St. Jude Medical Inc will begin trading on the exchange on Monday, December 2.
The stock will trade under the symbol STJ.N (corrects from "SJM.N").
St. Jude Medical develops, manufactures and distributes medical devices such as heart valves, cardiac rhythm-management systems, specialty catheters and other cardiovascular devices.
The shares have been trading on the Nasdaq.
